body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: ceafc0f8fef0ceac432f132b9aca2c09459a833b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking defects.

- Create, paste, and edit use the same taper check. The check uses the limits from the machine file. It does not supply missing limits.
- A zero taper remains permitted. A machine that uses an angle word does not need guide planes for this check.
- The generate and post checks remain in place.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream/main at `31a4bab97527f3b6574e9080461775b15fff7496`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App unit tests | 313 passed; 1 heavy test ignored |
| Quick gate: 15 app suites | 103 passed |
| Additional wire_post suite | 12 passed |
| Additional wire_taper_angle suite | 5 passed |
| Test build for app lib and six wire suites | Passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Safety checks:

1. Removed the taper check call in wire_gate. The MCP taper test failed because edit_operation accepted the taper.
2. Removed the maximum-taper refusal. The command test failed because the operation entered the document.

Both mutations gave the expected failure. Both files were restored and compared with their saved copies. The two changed suites then passed all 12 tests.

No golden files changed. I checked each changed assertion. The missing-guide case now checks refusal at command creation. The maximum-taper test still checks the named limit. The existing vertical NC, tapered NC, and tapered CL comparisons passed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge: none.

No GitHub runner was used. No real EDM control was tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: ceafc0f8fef0ceac432f132b9aca2c09459a833b -->
Review tier: effort:high model (safety floor - refusal at the command door). No escalation. Cost: about 120,000 tokens, about 30 tool calls, about 30 minutes wall (about 9 minutes of it cargo build and clippy). The meter at run time was not exact; the agent confirmed this total on close-out. Review was independent of the author.
